messages:
Priya: FYI — AcmeApp reached out, reporting a sharp spike in 429s and latency on our hosted API since 09:12 UTC. They say it coincided with a traffic blast from a scheduled batch job. sample log snippet they pasted: 

```
[2026-03-12T09:12:05Z] request_id=rx_9a2 model=redwood-v2-large route=/v1/generate status=429 customer_id=acme-123 tokens=1024
[2026-03-12T09:12:06Z] request_id=rx_9a3 model=redwood-v2-large route=/v1/generate status=200 latency_ms=512
[2026-03-12T09:12:06Z] request_id=rx_9a4 model=redwood-v2-large route=/v1/generate status=429 customer_id=acme-123 tokens=512
```

They want help attributing whether this was quota exhaustion (per-customer), route-level rate limiting, or a model-backed capacity event. I started a support ticket but escalating here because dashboards/alerts might tell the truth.

Marcus: thanks — can you paste the customer_id and the exact route they hit? Also did they use a service key or user keys?

Priya: customer_id=acme-123, route=/v1/generate, they say the batch used the org API key (service key) with 40 concurrent workers. No unusual error codes other than intermittent 429 and elevated p95 latency (~500ms -> 1200ms).

Marcus: ok. I pulled the last 90 min from observability. Quick summary: token-level quota for acme-123 is 1M tokens/day, consumption spiked ~400k tokens in a 5-min window between 09:10–09:15. Rate-limiter logs show token_bucket drops for that org: 

```
2026-03-12T09:12:04Z bucket_drop org=acme-123 route=/v1/generate tokens_requested=1024 tokens_available=0
2026-03-12T09:12:05Z bucket_drop org=acme-123 route=/v1/generate tokens_requested=512 tokens_available=0
```

Marcus: that suggests quota exhaustion at the org level plus local route-level bursting limits. I'll check per-model capacity too.

Dana: I looked at serving telemetry — the nodes handling redwood-v2-large in region us-east-1 had CPU/GPU utilization hit 96% for a short burst, and the autoscaler didn't add new pods because the burst exceeded the configured scaling window. There were also many 'queue overflow' events in the runtime: 

```
queue_overflow node=inf-12 region=us-east-1 model=redwood-v2-large overflow_count=372 window=60s
```

Dana: TL;DR: combination of org token bucket exhaustion + a serving-side backlog causing increased latency and cascaded 429s.

Priya: helpful — customer is asking for concrete attribution so they can explain to their engineering manager. Best practice: show them the per-customer token histogram + route breakdown and a timeline overlay with 429 counts. Can we produce that and attach to the ticket?

Marcus: yes. I'll generate a quick per-customer time series and a query you can attach. Here's the ad-hoc query I ran in our metrics store (feel free to adapt): 

```
SELECT time_bucket('1m', ts) as minute,
  sum(tokens) FILTER (WHERE org_id='acme-123') as tokens_by_org,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE org_id='acme-123' AND status=429) as count_429_by_org,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE route='/v1/generate') as count_by_route
FROM requests_metrics
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '2 hours'
GROUP BY minute
ORDER BY minute;
```

Marcus: attach the timeseries to the ticket. The shape will clearly show tokens_by_org spiking right before the 429 peak.

SupportBot: Escalation created — incident-5427. Linked runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/rate-limit-attribution. Suggested owner: @Marcus.

Alex (SE): I chatted with the customer — their batch job is a retry loop without jitter. They ramped to 40 workers simultaneously and retried on 429 immediately, which amplified the burst. Suggested immediate mitigation: 1) temporary quota bump for acme-123 (conservative +20% for next 1 hour), 2) advise their infra to add exponential backoff with jitter on 429, 3) enable route-level soft-qps smoothing if available.

Rina (Billing): for quota bump we need a ticket explaining business justification. Priya can you confirm if they have an open paid plan or overage agreement?

Priya: they're on growth plan with monthly commitment but no auto-overages. I'll attach the invoice and note urgent bump request.

Marcus: Operational fixes — I recommend two short-term and one medium-term change: 
- short-term: grant a 1-hour token quota increase and add a temporary policy to reject concurrent requests >50 per org per route (soft cap) to limit amplification. 
- short-term: create an alert rule that fires when org token usage > 200k tokens in 5m AND p95 latency > 500ms (to catch bursts early). 
- medium-term: update autoscaler smoothing window and enable burst-aware scale-up for models flagged as mission-critical (redwood-v2-*) so the cluster scales faster on sudden load.

Dana: I'll submit a PR to tweak the autoscaler config for us-east-1 to allow more aggressive scale up during the 1:00–10:00 daily window where we see most traffic. Also adding a runtime counter to surface 'queue_overflow' per model per node into the dashboard.

Priya: thanks. Action items I'm putting on the ticket: attach metrics graphs (Marcus), request quota bump (Priya + Rina), provide customer mitigation guidance (Alex), adjust autoscaler + add queue_overflow metric (Dana). I'll post back once quota bump is approved.

Marcus: one more thing — to help attribution next time, ask customers to include `x-request-id` from their client logs (we correlate those with our ingress logs). Example curl repro they can run with their key: 

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ORG_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":512}' | jq .
```

Marcus: if they can share a captured `x-request-id` and approximate client time, we can match exact requests in the logs.

Priya: perfect. I'll close the loop in the external ticket with the graphs and recommended fixes. Will report back when quota bump is done. :thumbsup: (reacts :eyes:)

SupportBot: incident-5427 status updated -> owner=Marcus, priority=high.

Marcus: follow-ups for the team: I'll post the dashboard snapshot to the ticket and propose default alert thresholds for burst detection in the next on-call doc.

Dana: PR created: https://staging.redwood/pull/8123 — adds queue_overflow metric and adjusts autoscaler window. Please review.

Priya: thanks everyone — great collaboration. If customer needs an immediate exec-friendly summary I can draft it with the attached graphs.

(End of thread)
